subject.title: [Bug]: In msteams channel messages, OpenClaw can't access inbound attachments

question: Which Microsoft Teams Graph media fallback policy should be canonical for this issue: automatic text/html fallback or default-off `channels.msteams.graphMediaFallback` opt-in?
rationale: Both open linked PRs address the same missing inbound attachment path but choose different operator and compatibility tradeoffs, and repository policy treats fallback/config surfaces as product-sensitive.

options.title: Make the config-gated fallback canonical
options.body: Land or revise https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096 if maintainers want explicit operator opt-in for extra Graph lookups while preserving mention-only behavior by default.

options.title: Make the automatic text/html fallback canonical
options.body: Land or revise https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90738 if maintainers accept best-effort Graph message lookup for non-personal Teams HTML stubs without adding config surface.

options.title: Request a combined replacement
options.body: Ask for one replacement PR if maintainers want the AAD/reply URL fixes from one branch and the default-off gate from the other before closing the redundant PR.

recommendation.title: Make the config-gated fallback canonical
recommendation.body: Land or revise https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101096 if maintainers want explicit operator opt-in for extra Graph lookups while preserving mention-only behavior by default.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is about Microsoft Teams plugin fallback policy and config-surface tradeoffs, and this owner has central plugin-boundary and recent inbound-media history.
